newsitem.title: USA: Iridium arranges $750 mln bank facility.
newsitem.headline: Iridium arranges $750 mln bank facility.

text.p: Iridium LLC said on Tuesday it signed a commitment letter with banks to provide a $750 million facility.
Borrowings under the facility will be subject to Iridium meeting certain program and funding milestones, the company said in a news release.
The banks involved are Chase Securities Inc, Chase Manhattan Bank and BZW, the investment banking division of Barclays Plc.
Iridium is a consortium of telecommunications and industrial companies planning to build a global satellite network linking wireless telephones.
Iridium shares closed up 1 to 22-3/8 in Nasdaq trading.
